purpose: Define buttons, toggles, sliders and other operational controls as request producers over exact operations/targets rather than direct implementation calls.

topics.name: Expose Operational Control Request
topics.purpose: Define buttons, toggles, sliders and other operational controls as request producers over exact operations/targets rather than direct implementation calls.

semantics.target_rule: Target is explicit and not inferred from focus/selection unless selection itself is an explicit typed binding.
semantics.argument_rule: Control state maps explicitly to operation arguments.
semantics.confirmation_rule: Optional destructive/sensitive confirmation is UI evidence only; canonical gates still apply.
semantics.feedback_rule: UI completion state derives from exact execution/result evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Enabled control does not mean caller is authorized.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: optimistic UI shown success without result
